rv.q: Rock ‘n’ Roll Panto: Rapunzel is pitched just right for families and is suitable viewing for basin cuts, blue rinses and mullets alike.
The plot takes a while to get going and gets slightly convoluted in the less focused second half.

cn.t: Critics find this Liverpool Everyman panto a spirited, freewheeling take on Rapunzel, with its hairdresser rivalry earning laughs. Actor-musicians and eclectic song choices shine, though results are mixed overall.
